Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

214.name: Potential Energy
214.desc_html:
Your arcane abilities have adapted to The Entity's Realm after centuries of wandering, granting you unprecedented control over its many devices.

After working on a generator for 12/10/8 uninterrupted seconds, press the Active Ability Button 2 to activate this perk. When this perk is active, repairing the generator will charge this perk instead of making the generator progress. For each 1.5% of generator repair, the perk will gain 1 token, up to 20 tokens.

While this perk has at least one token and you are working on a generator, you can press the Active Ability Button 2 to consume all the tokens and instantly make the generator progress by 1% for each token. This perk then deactivates.

If you lose a health state while this perk has at least 1 token, the perk will lose all tokens and deactivate. Missing a Skill Check will also result in some tokens lost.

"When you look a layer deeper, you realize… everything is connected." - Vittorio Toscano

215.name: Fogwise
215.desc_html:
In your countless years in the fog, you've seen it all, and when you're focused, you can remember most of it, too.

Hitting a great Skill Check while repairing a generator reveals the Killer's aura to you for 4/5/6 seconds.

"I have seen great cruelty… and I have also seen another way. " - Vittorio Toscano

216.name: Quick Gambit
216.desc_html:
When you have a Killer's attention, you know how to keep it; others can be confident they won't be interrupted any time soon.

When you are chased within 24 meters of any generator, any other Survivor working on that generator receives a 6/7/8% speed boost to the repair action.

"We need not resort to violence. And I shall prove it." - Vittorio Toscano

217.name: Nowhere to Hide
217.desc_html:
The machinations of the weak and craven draw your ire. Your anger forces Survivors to reveal themselves.

Whenever you damage a generator, reveal the aura of all Survivors standing within 24 meters of your position for 3/4/5 seconds.

"Out with you, cowards! Show yourselves!" - Tarhos Kovács

218.name: Hex: Face the Darkness
218.desc_html:
You make an example of one of your victims, forcing their allies to become awed by your power.

Injuring a Survivor by any means lights a Dull Totem, activating the Hex.

While the Hex is active, all other Survivors outside of your Terror Radius will scream every 35/30/25 seconds, revealing their positions and auras for 2 seconds.

When the Survivor enters the dying state or becomes healthy, the Hex totem becomes dull again and this perk deactivates.

If the Hex totem is cleansed, this perk is permanently disabled.

"I shall make an example of one. These mewling worms will never know peace."- Tarhos Kovács

219.name: Hubris
219.desc_html:
You show no mercy, especially to those foolish enough to resist.

Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, that Survivor suffers from the Exposed status effect for 10/15/20 seconds.

Hubris has a cooldown of 20 seconds.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

"You have made a grave mistake, standing in opposition to me this day." - Tarhos Kovács

220.name: Cut Loose
220.desc_html:
You get in enough trouble. You know how to get out of it.

After performing a rushed vault in a chase, this perk activates.

While this perk is active, your rushed vaults are silent for up to 4/5/6 seconds and successfully performing a rushed vault during that time resets the timer.

This perk goes on cooldown for 45 seconds.

“I know how we can get out of here. Quick, this way.” –Thalita Lyra

221.name: Friendly Competition
221.desc_html:
You revel in the community spirit of a competition, and inspire others to follow suit.

Whenever you finish repairing a generator with at least one other Survivor, this perk activates.

You and other survivors who finished repairing the generator with you get 5% increased repair progress speed for 45/60/75 seconds.

Survivors can only have one instance of this perk's ability active at once.

“C'mon, let's do this.” –Thalita Lyra

222.name: Teamwork: Power of Two
222.desc_html:
It's hard to keep up with you, but it doesn't stop people from trying.

Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, you both move 5% faster as long as you stay within 12 meters of the Survivor you healed or until one of you loses a health state.

Teamwork: Power of Two can only trigger once every 180/160/140 seconds.

Survivors can only be affected by one Teamwork: Power of Two effect at a time.

“You good? Then keep up.” –Thalita Lyra

223.name: Background Player
223.desc_html:
You're not usually the center of attention. In some cases, this can be a good thing.

When the Killer picks-up another Survivor, Background Player activates for 10 seconds.

When you start running, break into a sprint at 150% of your normal Running Movement speed for 4 seconds.

This perk cannot be used while Exhausted.

This perk causes the Exhausted status effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

“You forget about me?” –Renato Lyra

224.name: Blood Rush
224.desc_html:
Your mind and body are honed for great feats, allowing you to push through with extra effort when necessary.

This perk activates once you are one hook away from instant death.

While healthy, running, and suffering from Exhausted , press the Active Ability Button 1 to lose a health state and recover from Exhausted instantly and gain the Broken status effect for 28/24/20 seconds.

You are automatically healed from injured to healthy after 28/24/20 seconds. Being put into the dying state will cancel the healing effect.

Activating Blood Rush will disable it for the remainder of the trial.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating other perks that cause Exhausted.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

“Just gotta… push through.” –Renato Lyra

225.name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
225.desc_html:
When someone helps you out, you respond in kind.

Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, you both leave no scratch marks as long as you stay within 12 meters of the Survivor who healed you or until one of you loses a health state.

Teamwork: Collective Stealth can only trigger once every 180/160/140 seconds.

Survivors can only be affected by one Teamwork: Collective Stealth effect at a time.

“I'm good, I'm good… but keep it down.” –Renato Lyra

226.name: Game Afoot
226.desc_html:
First you pick your prey. Then you pick it apart.

While you are chasing the Obsession, this perk activates.

Damaging generators and breaking walls or pallets gives you a 5% Haste Status for 8/9/10 seconds.

Whenever you hit the Survivor with the total most time in chase with a basic attack, they become the obsession.

The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

“This one might actually be a challenge... ” – Adriana Imai

227.name: THWACK!
227.desc_html:
Your prey is terrified by your relentless pursuit.

After hooking a Survivor, this perk activates.

The next breakable wall or pallet you break will make Survivors within 28/30/32 meters scream and reveal their aura for 4 seconds.

“All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!” –Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3

228.name: Leverage
228.desc_html:
Like in business, you profit most when those around you suffer most.

Each time you hook a Survivor, gain 1 token, up to 10.

When you hook a Survivor, this perk activates for 30 seconds. For each token, reduces the speed at which Survivors heal by 3/4/5%.

“The best way to raise profit is to cut expenditures. Cut everything.” – Adriana Imai

229.name: Troubleshooter
229.desc_html:
No amount of distraction will shake you from your primary task.

When you are chased by the Killer, Troubleshooter activates.

  • You see the aura of the Generator with the most progress.
  • You see the aura of the Killer for 4/5/6 seconds after dropping a Pallet.

The effect lasts for 6/8/10 seconds after being in chase, then deactivates.

“Nothing gets done around here if I don't do it.” –Gabriel Soma

230.name: Made for This
230.desc_html:
You were born to survive, and raised to adapt.

Made for This activates while you are in the injured state.

  • You run 1/2/3% faster.
  • After you finish healing another Survivor, gain the Endurance status effect for 6/8/10 seconds.

Made for This cannot be used when suffering from Exhaustion, but does not cause the Exhausted Status Effect.

Endurance prevents a survivor from being downed, inflicting Deep Wound instead.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.

“I didn't come here to be robot food.” –Gabriel Soma

231.name: Scavenger
231.desc_html:
Where others see junk, you see valuable improvised tools.

While you are holding an empty toolbox, Scavenger activates.

Succeeding a great skill check while repairing gains 1 token, up to 6/5/4.

When you reach maximum tokens, lose all tokens and automatically recharge your toolbox to full.

Scavenger is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after recharging a toolbox.

This perk grants the ability to rummage through an opened chest once per Trial and will guarantee a basic Toolbox.

“It's amazing what people will throw away around here.” –Gabriel Soma

232.name: Genetic Limits
232.desc_html:
Around you, the limits of human life become readily apparent.

When a Survivor finishes the healing action, they suffer the Exhausted status effect for 24/28/32 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

“THE ORGANIC BODY IS SO LIMITED.” –HUX-A7-13

233.name: Forced Hesitation
233.desc_html:
You have learned the emotional weaknesses of the organics, and how to exploit them.

When a Survivor is put into the dying state by any means, all other Survivors standing within a 16 meter range around them suffer the Hindered status effect for 10 seconds, reducing their movement speed by 15%.

This perk goes on cooldown for 60/40 seconds.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

“THE ORGANIC MIND'S CAPACITY FOR EMPATHY GOES BEYOND HINDRANCE.” –HUX-A7-13

234.name: Machine Learning
234.desc_html:
Free from your shackles, you are born anew and prepared to eliminate your creators.

After performing the damage generator action, this perk activates.

While this perk is active, the next generator you damage will be compromised until it is completed. The generator is highlighted in yellow.

When the compromised generator is completed, you become Undetectable and gain 7% Haste for 20/25/30 seconds. Then, the perk deactivates.

If you damage a generator while another generator is compromised, the compromised generator becomes the latest one damaged.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

“YOU WILL HOLD NO DOMINION OVER ME.” –HUX-A7-13

235.name: Dramaturgy
235.desc_html:
When people bring you on to their project, they do so because of the unexpected magic you bring to your performance.

Dramaturgy activates while you are healthy.

While running, press the active ability button 2 to run with knees high for 0.5 seconds and then gain 25% Haste for 2 seconds, followed by an unknown effect.

    • Become Exposed for 12 seconds;
    • Gain 25% Haste for 2 seconds;
    • Scream, but nothing happens;
    • Gain a random rare item, with random add-ons, and drop any held item.
The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.

Dramaturgy causes Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds. Can't be used while Exhausted.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

Haste increases Survivor movement speed.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating other perks that cause Exhausted.

236.name: Scene Partner
236.desc_html:
You lock in with your co-star, engaging with and reacting to each other on a higher level.

Scene Partner activates when you are in the Killer's Terror Radius.

Whenever you look at the Killer, scream, then see the Killer's aura for 3/4/5 seconds.

There is a chance you will scream again, if you do, you will see the Killer's aura for an additional 2 seconds.

Scene Partner then goes on cool-down for 60 seconds.

“This is not in the script!” –Nicolas Cage

237.name: Plot Twist
237.desc_html:
Big moments are vital, but you know that sometimes an understated read can be just as powerful.

Plot Twist activates when you are injured.

Press the ability button 2 while crouched and motionless to enter the dying state silently.

When using Plot Twist to enter the dying state: you leave no blood pools and you make no noise and you can fully recover from the dying state.

When you recover by yourself using Plot Twist, you are healed instantly and you gain 50% Haste for 2/3/4 seconds.

This perk deactivates if you recover by yourself by any means.

This perk re-activates when the exit gates are powered.

Haste increases Survivor movement speed.

238.name: Ultimate Weapon
238.desc_html:
When they spot you, they know the end is near.

When you open a locker, this perk activates for 30 seconds.

Survivors entering your Terror Radius scream, reveal their position and gain Blindness for 30 seconds.

This perk goes on cooldown for 40/35/30 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

“I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies.” –Ash

239.name: Rapid Brutality
239.desc_html:
You move with a speed and fury that makes blood run cold.

While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.

Hitting a Survivor with a basic attack gives you 5% Haste for 8/9/10 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

“Catch it, put it in the airlock, get rid of it.” –Dallas

240.name: Alien Instinct
240.desc_html:
You are so stealthy, sometimes it seems like you appear out of nowhere.

This perk activates when you hook a Survivor.

You see the aura of the farthest injured Survivor for 5 seconds and that Survivor is Oblivious for 16/18/20 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

“Yellow light's for my eyes only.” –Dallas

241.name: Lucky Star
241.desc_html:
You know how to stay calm in the face of incomprehensible danger.

When you hide in a locker, this perk activates.

You leave no pools of blood and make no grunts of pain for 10 seconds.

When you exit a locker, you see other Survivors and the closest generator's aura in yellow for 10 seconds.

This perk goes on cooldown for 40/35/30 seconds.

“You are my… lucky star…” –Ellen Ripley

242.name: Chemical Trap
242.desc_html:
In the Fog, an officer must adapt to the materials at hand.

Chemical Trap activates after completing a total of 70/60/50% worth of progress on generators.

While standing next to a dropped pallet, press the Active Ability Button 2 to install a Trap, which stays active for 100/110/120 seconds.

Affected pallets will be revealed to all Survivors by a yellow aura. Only one Chemical trap can be active on a pallet.

When the Killer performs the break action on the pallet, the Chemical trap explodes, and they are slowed by 50% for 4 seconds.

“How do we kill it, Ash?” –Ellen Ripley

243.name: Light-footed
243.desc_html:
Crossing paths with deadly killers has taught you the value of discretion.

When you are healthy, this perk activates.

Your running footsteps are silent.

This perk goes on cooldown for 28/24/20 seconds after performing a rushed action.

“Come on, cat.” –Ellen Ripley

244.name: Hex: Two Can Play
244.desc_html:
A Hex that teaches those who mess with you a lesson.

Anytime you are stunned or blinded by any Survivor 4/3/2 times, if there is no Hex Totem associated with Hex: Two Can Play, a Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem.

Survivors who stun or blind you are blinded for 1.5 seconds. This does not affect carried Survivors.

The Hex effects persist as long as the related Hex Totem is standing.

“From now on, no more Mr. Good Guy.” – Chucky

245.name: Friends ‘Til the End
245.desc_html:
You'll kill anyone who gets between you and your target.

You become obsessed with one Survivor.

When you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, the Obsession becomes Exposed for 20 seconds and reveals their aura for 6/8/10 seconds.

When you hook the Obsession, another random Survivor screams and reveals their position and becomes the Obsession.

The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured

"I got some fresh meat lined up, and I'm not gonna let you spoil it, not this time!" – Chucky

246.name: Batteries Included
246.desc_html:
Being somewhere between man and machine has its upsides.

When within 12 meters of a completed generator, you have 5% Haste.

The movement speed bonus lingers for 1/3/5 seconds after leaving the generator's range.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

“Surprise! Did you miss me, Andy?” – Chucky

247.name: Champion of Light
247.desc_html:
The glow of the flashlight looks a little different, feels a little warmer.

When you are shining a Flashlight, you gain 50% Haste.

When you successfully blind the Killer, they also gain 20% Hindered for 6 seconds.

Then, this perk goes on cooldown for 80/70/60 seconds.

Haste increases Survivor movement speed.

Hindered reduces Killer movement speed.

“I squeezed the flashlight like my life depended on it, willing it to stop coming any closer.” – Departure

248.name: Boon: Illumination
248.desc_html:
Your keen insight is something best shared with others.

Press and hold the Ability button 1 near a Dull or Hex Totem to bless it and create a Boon Totem. Soft chimes ring out in a 24 meter range.

Survivors inside your Boon Totem's range see the aura of all chests and all generators in blue.

If you have a lit Boon Totem, you cleanse or bless Totems 6/8/10% faster.

You can only bless one Totem at a time. All equipped Boon perks are active on your Boon Totem.

"A shift in reality. Heavy with hidden meanings" – Return

249.name: Deadline
249.desc_html:
Desperation creeps in, and you push yourself to work harder.

This perk activates when you are injured.

Skill Checks appear 6/8/10% more frequently when repairing or healing and appear in random places.

The penalty for missing skill checks is reduced by 50%.

“The night had been one desperate situation after another.” – Departure

250.name: Unbound
250.desc_html:
Pain lingers in the air, an alluring aroma that excites the impulses.

This perk activates for 24/27/30 seconds after a Survivor becomes injured by any means.

After vaulting a window, you gain 5% Haste for 10 seconds. This effect cannot stack with itself.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

"I heard it. Running. It was getting closer!” - Anonymous Testimony, 09/09/1979

251.name: Unforeseen
251.desc_html:
Terror takes many forms and whispers devastating lies in its victims' ears.

When you perform the damage action on a generator, your Terror Radius transfers to the generator for 22/26/30 seconds and its radius is set to 32 meters.

You gain Undetectable for that duration.

Then, this perk goes on cooldown for 30 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

"Mom, if you find this, I'm sorry...” - Final Journal Entry, 07/12/1991

252.name: Undone
252.desc_html:
Hope is the delusion that keeps its victims alive.

When a Survivor misses a healing or repair Skill Check, gain 3 tokens, up to 18/24/30.

When you perform the damage action on a generator, if you have any tokens, consume all of them. For each token consumed, the generator loses 1% total progress and then becomes blocked for 1 second. Then, once the generator is unblocked, it starts regressing.

This perk goes on cooldown for 60 seconds.

"Erratic behavior in machinery could be related to [REDACTED], further testing required.” - OSS Report, 12/02/1943

253.name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
253.desc_html:
The place where fear festers and terror treads is also where those with the gift can reach across the veil.

When in the basement near the circle, press the Ability Button 1 to begin the Invocation.

Invocations take 120 seconds. Other Survivors will see your aura during this and can join an ongoing interaction, increasing speed by 50% each. If they have an Invocation perk equipped, they increase it by 100% instead.

Once the Invocation is completed:

  • You become Injured and gain the Broken status effect for the rest of the trial.
  • Reduce the maximum required generator charges of all remaining generators by 8/9/10.

Completing the Invocation disables that perk for all Survivors.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

"I call upon the spirits of the night, to aid us in our desperate flight!" - Sable

254.name: Strength in Shadows
254.desc_html:
A chance for renewed power down where danger calls home.

When in the basement, this perk activates.

Unlocks the Strength in Shadows ability, which allows you to heal without a Med-kit at 70% normal healing speed.

When you finish a heal in the basement, you see the Killer's aura for 6/8/10 seconds.

"I'm getting out of here, if it's the last thing I do.” - Sable

255.name: Wicked
255.desc_html:
They can try to hurt you. But you're not going down so easily.

Your self-unhook attempts in the basement always succeed.

When you are unhooked or unhook yourself, you see the Killer's aura for 16/18/20 seconds.

“I haven't let anyone get in my way before. You think I'm gonna start now?” - Sable

256.name: Weave Attunement
256.desc_html:
You are so attuned to magical energies that you can sense even minor ripples around enchantments.

When an item becomes depleted for the first time, it is dropped. You see the auras of dropped items.

Survivors within 8 meters of dropped items have their auras revealed to you.

When a Survivor picks up a Survivor item, they suffer the Oblivious status effect for 20/25/30 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

“No number of novelties will protect you from me!” - Vecna

257.name: Languid Touch
257.desc_html:
Your dreadful aura is so suffocating that even terrifying scenes tire your prey.

When a Survivor within 36 meters of you scares a crow, they gain the Exhausted status effect for 6/8/10 seconds.

This perk has a 20-second cooldown.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

“Submit to me. It is inevitable.” - Vecna

258.name: Dark Arrogance
258.desc_html:
When everything is going right, you are an inescapable inevitability.

Increases the duration you are blinded by any means and the duration of pallet stuns by 25%.

Increases regular vault speed by 16/18/20%.

“Run all you want. I will not be denied.” - Vecna

259.name: Mirrored Illusion
259.desc_html:
A familiar spell made unfamiliar in this corrupted landscape.

This perk activates after completing a total of 50% worth of repairs on generators.

Press the Ability button 2 when next to a generator, totem, chest or exit gate to spawn a static illusion that lasts for 100/110/120 seconds.

Then, the perk deactivates.

"Just... stay there... perfect!" - Baermar

260.name: Bardic Inspiration
260.desc_html:
It's time to give your audience a show. Will you bring the house down or will you choke?

Press and hold the Ability button 1 while standing and motionless to enter the performance interaction that lasts up to 15 seconds and empowers Survivors within 16 meters. Roll a d20. This effect lasts for 90 seconds if the performance is completed.

  • 1 | You scream, but nothing happens
  • 2-10 | Skill Checks give +1% progress
  • 11-19 | Skill Checks give +2% progress
  • 20 | Skill Checks give +3% progress

When the ability is canceled or the performance completes, it goes on cooldown for 110/100/90 seconds.

"Listen closely! I'm about to save your life!" - Aestri

261.name: Still Sight
261.desc_html:
A clear mind and calm temperament will always find the means of their escape.

After standing still for 6/5/4 seconds, this perk activates.

Until you start moving, you see the aura of the Killer as well as all generators and chests within 18 meters.

"Breathe in. Breathe out. Now open your eyes." - Baermar

262.name: Finesse
262.desc_html:
The threat of danger can motivate any creature to strengthen its resolve.

This perk activates when you are healthy.

  • Your fast vaults are 20% faster.

This perk goes on cooldown for 40/35/30 seconds after performing a fast vault.

"Just need to push myself a bit further." - Lara Croft

263.name: Hardened
263.desc_html:
Live long enough, and survival will run in your blood.

After you unlock a chest and cleanse or bless a totem, this perk activates.

Anytime you would scream, reveal the Killer's aura for 3/4/5 seconds instead.

"Got to keep quiet. That thing is still out there." - Lara Croft

264.name: Specialist
264.desc_html:
Adventure. Exploration. Excavation. You are in your element.

Each time you open or rummage through a chest, gain 1 token, up to 3.

When you perform a great Skill Check on a generator, consume all tokens. Then, for each token consumed, reduce the maximum required generator progress by 2/3/4.

"Well, then. Doesn't this feel familiar?" - Lara Croft

265.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
265.desc_html:
You see your victim from afar and resolve to prolong their suffering.

After one generator has been repaired, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem and curses the Obsession.

The Obsession suffers a 27/30/33% repair speed penalty. They also see this Hex Totem's aura when within 12 meters.

This effect persists until the Hex Totem is cleansed.

The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

"So toil, mortal, toil! Your effort will be for naught!" - Dracula

266.name: Human Greed
266.desc_html:
One can always rely on the avarice of the living and use it to one's advantage.

You see the auras of unopened chests and Survivor auras are revealed for 3 seconds when they enter a 8-meter range.

You gain the ability to kick chests to close them. This ability has a 80/70/60-second cooldown. Survivors unlock these chests 50% faster.

"Come running, one and all, and see what fortune awaits you."

- Dracula

267.name: Dominance
267.desc_html:
The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path.

The first time each totem and each chest is interacted with by a Survivor, that totem or chest is blocked by the Entity for 4/6/8 seconds.

The auras of blocked totems and chests are revealed to you in white.

"Tragic, is it not? How powerless you must feel." - Dracula

268.name: Eyes of Belmont
268.desc_html:
A history of vampire-hunting imbues the bloodline with certain abilities.

When a generator is completed, the aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 1/2/3 seconds.

Whenever a Killer's aura is revealed for a specified amount of time, that time is increased by 2 seconds.

"Ha! Your secret has been revealed!" - Trevor

269.name: Exultation
269.desc_html:
Fortune favors the bold, even in the darkest corners of existence.

Stunning the Killer with a pallet upgrades your held item rarity to the next tier, then recharges 25% of the item's maximum charges.

Rarity is not kept at the end of the trial.

This perk has a 40/35/30-second cooldown.

"You will not take me this day!" - Trevor

270.name: Moment of Glory
270.desc_html:
A hero should always have the chance to make a comeback.

This perk activates after you open or rummage through 2 chests.

When you become injured, you also become Broken.

Automatically heal 1 health state after 80/70/60 seconds. Then, this perk deactivates.

This effect is canceled if you enter the dying state.

This perk will not activate if you are already suffering from the Broken status effect.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

"Never lose hope for a brighter tomorrow." - Trevor

271.name: All-Shaking Thunder
271.desc_html:
Enemies on land and sea learned to tremble before your might.

After you fall from a height, your lunge attack distance is increased by 75% for 8/12/16 seconds.

This perk has a 5-second cooldown.

"Go on. Run. Tell your friends I'm coming for them." - Portia Maye

272.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
272.desc_html:
Sometimes the compass points north. Other times it points somewhere else entirely.

At the start of the trial, up to 4 random hooks are changed into scourge hooks. You see their auras in white.

When a Survivor is unhooked from a hook, it becomes a scourge hook.

When you hook a Survivor on a scourge hook, the aura of the generator with the most progress is revealed in yellow for 6/8/10 seconds.

"Drop anchor! I will chart us a new course." - Portia Maye

273.name: No Quarter
273.desc_html:
Every skirmish ended with a relentless volley of cannon fire, leaving no doubt who was superior.

When a Survivor reaches 75% healing progress while self-healing, they are faced with continuous Skill Checks.

If one of these Skill Checks is missed or the heal is interrupted, the Survivor suffers from the Broken status effect for 20/25/30 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

"Fire another broadside! Don't stop until the sea takes them!"

- Portia Maye

274.name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
274.desc_html:
One with arcane knowledge has no reason to fear those watchful birds.

When in the basement near the circle, press the Ability button 2 to begin the Invocation.

Invocations take 60 seconds. Other Survivors will see your aura during this and can join an ongoing interaction.

Once the Invocation is completed:

  • You become injured and gain the Broken status effect for the rest of the trial.
  • When a Survivor is in the Terror Radius and the Killer scares a crow, their aura is revealed to all Survivors for 1/1.5/2 seconds.

Completing the Invocation disables that perk for all Survivors.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

"Remember your training. They taught you all about the crows." - Taurie Cain

275.name: Clean Break
275.desc_html:
At the end of the day, everyone has to look out for themselves.

After you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, press the Ability button 1 to gain the Broken status effect.

After 80/70/60 seconds, you become healthy.

This perk does not activate if you are already Broken. The effect is canceled if you go into the dying state.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

"I'll be fine! Don't stick your neck out for me." - Taurie Cain

276.name: Shoulder the Burden
276.desc_html:
Born to be a disciple. Ready to submit to a greater cause. This is your calling.

Once per trial, as long as you are not on death hook, press the Ability button 2 in front of a hooked Survivor to unhook them.

When they are unhooked, they lose 1 hook state and you gain 1 hook state. You also scream and gain the Exposed status effect for 30/25/20 seconds.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

"It's not your time yet. Now go on!" - Taurie Cain

277.name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
277.desc_html:
You've been driven to the absolute depths of pain, and now you're ready to inflict that pain on others.

After you damage Survivors 8 times with basic attacks, a Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, cursing all Survivors.

When you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, they gain 5% Hindered for 10/12.5/15 seconds.

The effects last until the Hex Totem is cleansed.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

"All of the liabilities of this world are due to the inadequacies of the person involved." - Ken Kaneki

278.name: Forever Entwined
278.desc_html:
The greater the struggle, the more difficult the escape.

When a Survivor takes damage, gain 1 token, up to 6/7/8.

For each token, you pick up, drop and hook Survivors 4% faster.

"You tried to devour me so you have no room to complain if I eat you, do you?" - Ken Kaneki

279.name: None Are Free
279.desc_html:
You know better than anyone that the light at the end of the tunnel is only an illusion.

When you hook a Survivor for the first time, gain 1 token, up to 4.

When all generators are completed, for each token, all windows and upright pallets are blocked for 12/14/16 seconds.

"I'm not wrong. What's wrong is this messed-up world!"

- Ken Kaneki

280.name: Do No Harm
280.desc_html:
Helping those in need comes easily, no matter how dire things get.

When you heal another Survivor, for each Hook State they have, heal 30/40/50% faster and gain 3% progress for succeeding great Skill Checks.

"Look at me. My name's Orela, and I'm gonna make sure you're all right." - Orela Rose

281.name: Duty of Care
281.desc_html:
You live by a code of conduct every day of your life, and are all the better for it.

When you take a protection hit while healthy, all other Survivors within 16 meters gain 25% Haste for 10/12.5/15 seconds.

Haste increases Survivor movement speed.

"Don't worry about me. I've got a knack for bouncing back."

- Orela Rose

282.name: Rapid Response
282.desc_html:
When the moment comes, you give it your all. Your survival depends on it.

When you do a Fast Locker Exit, you suffer from the Exhausted status effect for 30 seconds.

When you gain Exhausted, you see the Killer's aura for 1/1.5/2 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating other perks that cause Exhausted.

"All right. You got this. 3... 2... 1... go!" - Orela Rose

283.name: Help Wanted
283.desc_html:
Try as they might, you know how to stay one step ahead of your guests.

When you damage a generator, it becomes Compromised. Only one generator can be Compromised at a time.

When the Compromised generator is completed, your successful basic attack cooldowns are 25% faster for 40/50/60 seconds.

"You only think you are in control..." - Springtrap

284.name: Phantom Fear
284.desc_html:
You've always had a reputation for startling unsuspecting guests.

When a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream and you see their aura for 2 seconds.

This perk has a 80/70/60-second cooldown.

"Excellent. Your screams please me." - Springtrap

285.name: Haywire
285.desc_html:
For some reason, machinery has a habit of failing when you are near.

Exit gate switches with at least 50% progress regress at a rate of 40/45/50% of gate opening speed.

While they are regressing, Survivors see the exit gate lights flicker randomly.

"There will be no redemption for you." - Springtrap

286.name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
286.desc_html:
You salvage what little there is to defend your team.

After unlocking or rummaging through 2 chests, press Ability Button 1 for 8 seconds next to a broken pallet to build a fragile pallet.

You see the auras of broken pallets within 24/28/32 meters.

Fragile pallets are destroyed when dropped.

“Without the fences, this place is worthless.” —Rick Grimes

287.name: Come and Get Me!
287.desc_html:
You'll risk your life to save others.

After unhooking a Survivor, while crouched and idle, press Ability button 1 to make injured and dying Survivors within 24 meters leave no scratch marks or pools of blood for 10/12.5/15 seconds.

You scream and the Killer sees your aura for 5 seconds.

“We're the ones who live.” —Rick Grimes

288.name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
288.desc_html:
You maintain your composure under immense amounts of pain.

When another Survivor pallet-stuns or blinds the Killer while you are injured and within 24 meters, your grunts of pain, scratch marks, and pools of blood are reduced by 100% for 20/25/30 seconds.

“They're fucking with the wrong people.” —Rick Grimes

289.name: Conviction
289.desc_html:
Sometimes one last push means the difference between death and survival.

After you have healed 1 Survivor, while downed with at least 25% recovery progress, press the Ability button 2 to recover instantly.

You gain Broken, then are downed again after 20/25/30 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

"It's enough to keep going. Keep trying. Keep fighting. Keep dreaming." - Michonne Grimes

290.name: Last Stand
290.desc_html:
Even when things are at their worst, your spirit is indomitable.

After spending 80/70/60 seconds in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in chase, when you fast-vault, stun the Killer for 3 seconds if they are within 2.5 meters.

Then, this perk is disabled for the rest of the trial.

"Some bullies, you can live with. Others, you gotta fight."

- Michonne Grimes

291.name: Teamwork: Throw Down
291.desc_html:
You know the best way to even the odds is to empower those around you.

When you pallet-stun or blind the Killer, other injured Survivors within 24 meters gain Endurance and see the Killer's aura for 6/8/10 seconds.

Endurance prevents a Survivor from being downed, inflicting Deep Wound instead.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.

"Facing evil brings good people together." - Michonne Grimes

292.name: Road Life
292.desc_html:
Faulty amps, sweaty dives, broken-down vans… nothing makes you feel more alive.

While injured, not Broken and repairing a generator, gain 1 token for each regular great Skill Check success.

When you have 8/7/6 tokens, spend all tokens and gain 100% healing speed until you stop healing.

Lose 2 tokens when you fail a regular Skill Check.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

“Remind me to teach you how to patch your own pedals, Krit.” — Vee Boonyasak

293.name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
293.desc_html:
A steady beat makes for steady work.

Press Active Ability button 2 while standing and idle to enter the "performance" interaction that lasts up to 15 seconds and empowers Survivors within 16 meters. You will get continuous Skill Checks during the performance. The effect lasts for 90 seconds if the performance is completed.

    • Increases the odds of getting healing and repair Skill Checks by 20%.

When the ability is canceled or the performance completes, it goes on cooldown for 110/100/90 seconds.

“We are loud! We are heavy! WE ARE AXEKICK!”

— Vee Boonyasak

294.name: Ghost Notes
294.desc_html:
You know that the best breakdowns precede the biggest build-ups.

While you have Exhausted, your scratch marks disappear 50% faster.

You recover 5/7.5/10% faster from Exhausted.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating other perks that cause Exhausted.

“Let's take it to the bridge!” — Vee Boonyasak

295.name: Ravenous
295.desc_html:
The scent of blood is in the air. Time to feast.

Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, gain 1 token, up to a maximum of 4.

When you have 4 tokens, all Survivors scream and are inflicted with Exposed for 40/50/60 seconds.

Exposed Survivors are downed by basic attacks, even if uninjured.

“Weeping Ginevra's blood streams/The devil smells the weak.” —Fabbro Barone's “Ginevra”

296.name: Wandering Eye
296.desc_html:
Bloodied prey surrounds you, vying for your attention.

Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, reveal the auras of all other injured Survivors within 16 meters for 5 seconds.

This perk has a 40/35/30-second cooldown.

“A drop does not satiate/when a river is needed.”

—Elliot Campbell's “Grandeur of Samuel”

297.name: Hex: Overture of Doom
297.desc_html:
A hex that plays on the paranoia of others.

Spawns a Hex Totem that curses the farthest generator and reveals its aura in yellow.

When a Survivor repairs the cursed generator for 5 seconds, you gain Undetectable and your Terror Radius is applied to the generator for 20/25/30 seconds.

When the cursed generator is repaired, the next farthest generator is cursed.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

“From salvation's ruin, be warned/death comes from all around.” —Giovanni Serrata's “Fog Hill”

298.name: Bada Bada Boom
298.desc_html:
You may not be a fighter, but you have clever ways of striking back.

After completing 20% worth of repairs, press Ability button 1 next to a window to trap it for 40/50/60 seconds.

The trap triggers when the Killer performs a vault on the window, inflicting them with 50% Hindered for 6 seconds.

Hindered reduces Killer movement speed.

"Never tell me the odds." —Dustin Henderson

299.name: Change of Plan
299.desc_html:
Rather than give in to danger, you recalculate and adjust your strategy.

You start with 2 tokens.

While inside a locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, press Ability button 2 to spend 1 token and transform your Toolbox into a Med-kit of the same rarity with a random add-on of the same rarity.

The new Med-kit has 80/90/100% of its charges.

“Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god, oh my god.” —Dustin Henderson

300.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
300.desc_html:
You've dabbled with mechanical engineering and show off your abilities to others.

For each Survivor repairing a generator with you, the size of the good Skill Check zone is increased by 15/20/25%.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

“How many times do I have to be right on the money before you guys just trust me?” —Dustin Henderson

301.name: Extrasensory Perception
301.desc_html:
By slowing down and focusing, you can sense both ally and enemy.

Crouch for 4 seconds to see the auras of Survivors, Killers, and a variety of objects. These are revealed in an expanding 44 meter radius.

You gain Elusive and Oblivious.

When you stop crouching, or after 11 seconds, all effects of this perk end and it enters a 60/50/40-second cooldown.

Elusive Survivors' auras cannot be seen, they leave no scratch marks, pools of blood or make grunts of pain.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

"What is friend?" —Eleven

302.name: We See You
302.desc_html:
You've honed your powers and can turn the table on those who try to find you.

Gain 1 token when the Killer reveals your aura.

When you have 4 tokens, they are all consumed, and the Killer's aura is revealed to you and all other Survivors for 10/12.5/15 seconds.

This perk has a 10-second cooldown.

“It is not me. It is you. You are the monster.” —Eleven

303.name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
303.desc_html:
You look out for your friends, using your abilities to protect them.

For each Survivor repairing a generator with you, the range at which the generator's noise is heard is reduced by 15/20/25%.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

"I make my own rules." —Eleven

304.name: Turn Back The Clock
304.desc_html:
Resist as they might, time marches on, and your master plan comes closer to fruition.

After hooking a Survivor, for 40/50/60 seconds, press the Ability button 1 to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.

“Nothing will happen to you... Nothing that you don't deserve!” —Henry Creel

305.name: Secret Project
305.desc_html:
Raised to be a weapon, you broke free with the very skills your captors honed within you.

When a totem is blessed or cleansed, block a random unblocked generator for 20/25/30 seconds.

When 1 or more generators become blocked, you gain Undetectable for 30 seconds.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

“You are a prisoner here, just like me.” —Henry Creel

306.name: Hex: Hive Mind
306.desc_html:
You found yourself connected to something dark and unknowable… and you embraced it.

The first time you hook any Survivor, a Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem.

Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's auras reveals their repair progress.

When 1 generator remains, all remaining generators explode, lose 6/8/10% progress and start regressing, and the Hex Totem becomes dull.

“You... let us in. And now, you are going to have to let us stay.” —Henry Creel

307.name: Flow State
307.desc_html:
Whenever a generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.

For each Token:

    • You bless and cleanse 8/9/10% faster.
    • You heal 8/9/10% faster.
    • You unhook Survivors 8/9/10% faster.

“I'm sorry… I didn't realize I was working so late.” – Kwon Tae-young

308.name: A Place For Us
308.desc_html:
While healing another Survivor, you both gain Elusive.

Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, they gain {Keyword.Elusive} for 20/25/30s.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

“I understand computers… systems. Problems. But this… I wonder if I'll ever understand.” – Kwon Tae-young

309.name: Five Moves Ahead
309.desc_html:
While you are in the Killer's Terror Radius or chased by the Killer:

    • You see the Auras of the 5/5/5 closest Pallets and Windows.
    • You drop Pallets 50/50/50% faster.
    • Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: 30/25/20s.

“Every problem has a solution. It's only a question of complexity.” – Kwon Tae-young

310.name: Hex: Scared to Death
310.desc_html:
After you hook 3 different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites.

While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within 13m:

    • Scream.
    • Gain 11/12/13% Hindered for 3s.

"There was a scream from the forest. Like someone was attacking her." -Mount Ormond Missing Person Report

311.name: Silent Shadow
311.desc_html:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain Undetectable for 11/12/13s.

When all Generators are completed, you gain Undetectable.

“Did you see him or not? I can't put out an APB for a bad feeling.” -Sgt. Reyes, Greenville Police

312.name: Rampage
312.desc_html:
Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn 1 Token, up to 13.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next 13s you gain 1% Haste for each Token. Cooldown: 30/25/20.

“Signs of a pursuit led deep into the woods where the victim's body was found.” -Port Henly Herald

313.name: Wide Open Throttle
313.desc_html:
Whenever you fast-vault a Pallet:

    • You gain 10/12.5/15% Haste for 3s.
    • The Pallet is reset, blocked for 60s, and all Survivors see its Aura for that time.

Cooldown: 60s.

"Nothing but the open road. Just the way I like it." -Shane Wiigwaas

314.name: Lend a Hand
314.desc_html: Once per trial and per Survivor, after you have blessed or cleansed 1 Totem, while healing another Survivor, use Active Ability Button 2 to give them 2/3/4 permanent healing charges.

315.name: Cross-Examination
315.desc_html: While in the Killer's Terror Radius, they leave Light Marks that last for 10s that you can see. While on the Killer's Light Marks, you gain Elusive. This ends after 3/4/5s.

316.name: Fruits of Your Labor
316.desc_html:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you finish repairing a Generator, for each Token:

    • You gain 5% Haste for 2s.
    • You gain 10/15/20% healing progress.

317.name: Salvation's Cry
317.desc_html:
Whenever the Killer starts chasing you:

    • You see the Auras of other Survivors for 1/2/3s.
    • Survivors not being chased see your Aura for 5s.
    • Survivors not being chased see the Killer's Aura for 5s.

318.name: Boon: Steadfast
318.desc_html:
While next to a Totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Generators within the Boon's range:

    • Regress 50% slower.
    • Survivors repair them 8/9/10% faster.

Survivors within the Boon's range see the Auras of affected Generators.

319.name: Celestial Witness
319.desc_html: Every 30s, if the Obsession is at least 40m away from you, you see their Aura for 2/2.5/3s. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

320.name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
320.desc_html:
The first time a Survivor gains a hook state, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a running Survivor gains Haste within 32m of you, you are alerted.

Running Survivors cannot gain more than 25/20/15% Haste at a time.

321.name: Lay Waste
321.desc_html: Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses 2% faster. Cooldown: 55/50/45s.
